SELECT f.channel_code, s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, s.store_id, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
WHERE s.store_id >= 900 OR f.channel_code <> 'ST'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH s AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) nonstaff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
d AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.store_id, n.store_name, n.sqm, round(s.gross_net) sales, round(coalesce(r.ret,0)) ret, round(s.gross_net - coalesce(r.ret,0)) net_after, round(s.nonstaff-coalesce(r.ret,0)) net_nonstaff, round(d.rpt_before) rpt_before, round(d.rpt_net) rpt_net
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN d USING (store_id) JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) n USING (store_id)
ORDER BY net_after DESC

WITH dup AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, sum(net_amount) amt, min(etl_loaded_at) e1, max(etl_loaded_at) e2
 FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT st.store_id, count(*) dup_groups, sum(c) lines, sum(amt - amt/c) excess, min(e1), max(e2)
FROM dup JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sales_line_id = (SELECT min(sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line g WHERE g.receipt_id=dup.receipt_id AND g.line_no=dup.line_no)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_return_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sales_line_id, return_date, product_key, quantity_returned ORDER BY return_line_id) = 1),
fy AS (SELECT fiscal_year, min(period_start_date) s, max(period_end_date) e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar GROUP BY 1),
a AS (
  SELECT fy.fiscal_year, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) sales FROM sales f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN fy ON f.sale_date BETWEEN fy.s AND fy.e WHERE st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (
  SELECT fy.fiscal_year, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret FROM rets r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN fy ON r.return_date BETWEEN fy.s AND fy.e WHERE st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.store_id, a.sales - coalesce(b.ret,0) net FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (fiscal_year, store_id)),
rk AS (SELECT *, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year ORDER BY net DESC) rnk FROM c)
SELECT rk.store_id, d.store_name, max(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN rnk END) r2425, max(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN rnk END) r2526, max(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN rnk END) r2627,
 round(max(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END)) net2526,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line) nret, (SELECT count(*) FROM rets) nret_dedup
FROM rk JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) d USING (store_id)
GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING min(rnk) <= 12 ORDER BY r2526

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1),
a AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) sales FROM sales f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
b AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.sales - coalesce(b.ret,0) DESC) AS rank, a.store_id, d.store_name, round(a.sales - coalesce(b.ret,0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (store_id) JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) d USING (store_id)
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
